platform.evidence: proposal.md Why adds an observation from the same app.min.js?v=1994234, read through cdp.py. Trailers.onCreate removes .view--trailer for adult cards, cards without videos and disable_features.trailers. The card calls _this.build(rows) before Listener.send('full', {type: 'complite'}), so the removal precedes complite. #sprite-trailer is a symbol inside svg in the device DOM, and the template's own .view--trailer uses it. Decisions 4 and 5 cite this. Using the source order instead of opening a live card with no videos is acceptable: the source text is the reference. The other behaviours were observed in round 1.

replaced.evidence: In tasks.md 3.1 and the Impact list, open-card.js now resets window.__kpRuTrailer before the «1+1» run and gives the reason (Activity.push does not reload the page). So playing.js checks the service key only in the two «Зверь» passes, by button and by list, and the «1+1» pass only checks that a trailer plays. The plugin replaces no project input and drops no guard.

catcher.evidence: design.md Risks now gives each case and what happens. If show becomes async, the interceptor is not called and show is already restored, so the engine shows its own list, with the decision 3 warning. If the handler is gone or items changes shape, nothing launches and only the console warning remains. If on.js inserts its button first, «Трейлер» lands one step further from «Смотреть». In every case the catcher reached is the user, with «Смотреть» → «Трейлеры» still working, and then bash tests/live/kp-trailers.sh (including button-focus) on the next plugin change. The Risks reject a scheduled run on goal 2 and keep Lampa.Noty out per §VII. Both choices are traceable and reasoned.

length.evidence: The spec is unchanged since round 1. One ADDED requirement of about 75 words; every SHALL/MUST sentence is asserted by a mapped unit test or live step. «Трейлеры» staying in the «Смотреть» menu is asserted by the retained menu-focus passes in kp-trailers.sh.
